product_name.en: 9D7N Impression of Shanxi and Inner Mongolia

highlights.en: Ordos — Ordos Grassland, Traditional Welcome Wine & Hada Ceremony, Mongolian Costume Experience, Grassland Bonfire Party, Traditional Mongolian Culture
highlights.zh: 鄂尔多斯 — 鄂尔多斯草原、下马酒及献哈达迎宾仪式、蒙古族服饰换装体验、草原篝火晚会、蒙古族传统文化体验

highlights.en: Xiangshawan — Xiangshawan Desert, Desert Cableway Experience
highlights.zh: 响沙湾 — 响沙湾沙漠、沙漠索道体验

highlights.en: Ulan Hada Volcano — Ulan Hada Volcano Geopark, Spacesuit Costume Experience
highlights.zh: 乌兰哈达火山 — 乌兰哈达火山地质公园、太空服换装体验

highlights.zh: 呼和浩特 — 宽巷子、鄂尔多斯文化产业园、颐和生态文化博览园、康巴什旅游景区

highlights.en: Ningwu — Wannian Ice Cave, Millennium Natural Ice Wonder, Hanging Village, Cliffside Ancient Settlement
highlights.zh: 宁武 — 万年冰洞、千年天然冰洞奇观、悬空村、悬崖古村落

highlights.en: Datong — Yungang Grottoes, Datong Ancient City
highlights.zh: 大同 — 云冈石窟、大同古城

title.zh: 新加坡 > 吉隆坡 > 鄂尔多斯

sections._note: PDF 排版问题：中文第 1 句「于吉隆坡国际机场集合，搭乘航班飞往鄂尔多斯。」丢失了 ✦ 标记，被粘在英文第 2 条末尾；此处按语义还原为 2 条中英配对。另：标题中 Singapore 与 Kuala Lumpur 之间的 > 箭头在 PDF 文字层中缺失，按语义补上。

title.en: Depart for Ordos via Kuala Lumpur
title.zh: 经吉隆坡飞往鄂尔多斯

description.en: Assemble at Kuala Lumpur International Airport and take the flight to Ordos.
description.zh: 于吉隆坡国际机场集合，搭乘航班飞往鄂尔多斯。

description.en: Upon arrival, meet your local guide and transfer to the hotel for check-in and rest.
description.zh: 抵达鄂尔多斯后，由专业导游接机，乘车前往酒店办理入住并休息。

title.zh: 鄂尔多斯 > 鄂尔多斯草原

description.en: Breakfast / Lunch / -
description.zh: 早餐 / 午餐 / -

description.en: Travel approximately 2.5 hours to the Ordos Grassland.
description.zh: 早餐后乘车前往辽阔的【鄂尔多斯草原】。

trip_items.photo_subject: Ordos Grassland 鄂尔多斯草原

title.zh: 下马酒及献哈达迎宾仪式

description.en: Receive a traditional Mongolian welcome with wine and a ceremonial hada.
description.zh: 抵达草原后，接受蒙古族传统下马酒及献哈达迎宾仪式。

trip_items.photo_subject: Mongolian Hada Welcome Ceremony 蒙古族献哈达迎宾仪式

description.en: Dress in traditional Mongolian costume and experience the colourful culture of the grasslands.
description.zh: 换穿蒙古族传统服饰，感受草原民族文化，并留下特色纪念照片。

trip_items.photo_subject: Mongolian Traditional Costume 蒙古族传统服饰

description.en: Admire the wide-open prairie, yurts, livestock and dramatic skies.
description.zh: 游览草原景区，欣赏辽阔草原、蒙古包、牛羊及蓝天白云组成的塞外风光。

trip_items.photo_subject: Ordos Grassland Yurts 鄂尔多斯草原蒙古包

description.en: Join a lively Grassland Bonfire Party in the evening.
description.zh: 晚上参加热闹的【草原篝火晚会】，与当地蒙古族同胞载歌载舞。

trip_items.photo_subject: Grassland Bonfire Party 草原篝火晚会

title.zh: 鄂尔多斯草原 > 响沙湾 > 鄂尔多斯

description.en: Breakfast / Lunch / Dinner
description.zh: 早餐 / 午餐 / 晚餐

description.en: Travel to Xiangshawan, one of Inner Mongolia’s celebrated singing-sand destinations.
description.zh: 早餐后离开鄂尔多斯草原，乘车前往著名的【响沙湾】。

trip_items.photo_subject: Xiangshawan Desert 响沙湾沙漠

description.en: The tour includes scenic-area admission and cableway transportation.
description.zh: 行程包含响沙湾景区门票及索道，乘坐索道进入沙漠景区。

trip_items.photo_subject: Xiangshawan Desert Cableway 响沙湾沙漠索道

description.en: Admire the sweeping dunes, golden desert scenery and camel caravans.
description.zh: 欣赏辽阔沙丘、金色沙海及沙漠驼队风光，感受响沙湾独特的鸣沙奇观。

trip_items.photo_subject: Xiangshawan Sand Dunes Camel Caravan 响沙湾沙漠驼队

title.en: Optional Desert Activities and Return to Ordos
title.zh: 自选沙漠娱乐项目后返回鄂尔多斯

description.en: Additional desert activities at Yuesha Island are available at guests’ own choice. Return to Ordos after the visit.
description.zh: 可根据个人兴趣自愿参加悦沙岛等沙漠娱乐项目。游览结束后返回鄂尔多斯入住酒店。

description.en: Breakfast / Lunch / Dinner
description.zh: 早餐 / 午餐 / 晚餐

sections._note: 英文 4 条 ✦、中文只有 3 条 ✦：中文「走进四季不化的天然冰洞，欣赏冰柱、冰瀑、冰笋及晶莹冰壁构成的冰雪奇观。」一句丢失了 ✦ 标记（PDF 中另起一行），语义上对应英文第 3 条，此处按语义还原为 4 条配对。

description.en: Travel approximately four hours from Ordos to Ningwu.
description.zh: 早餐后乘车前往山西宁武。

description.en: Visit the remarkable Wannian Ice Cave, including admission and cableway transportation.
description.zh: 游览神秘的【万年冰洞】，行程包含景区门票及索道。

trip_items.photo_subject: Wannian Ice Cave Ningwu 宁武万年冰洞

description.en: Explore its permanent ice formations, frozen waterfalls and brilliant blue-white ice walls.
description.zh: 走进四季不化的天然冰洞，欣赏冰柱、冰瀑、冰笋及晶莹冰壁构成的冰雪奇观。

trip_items.photo_subject: Wannian Ice Cave ice formations 万年冰洞冰柱冰瀑

description.en: Continue to the Hanging Village, an ancient settlement built along the mountain cliffs.
description.zh: 随后游览【悬空村】，欣赏依山而建的古老村落及悬崖民居景观。

trip_items.photo_subject: Ningwu Hanging Village 宁武悬空村

title.zh: 宁武 > 忻州 > 应县 > 大同

description.en: Breakfast / Lunch / -
description.zh: 早餐 / 午餐 / -

sections._note: 英文 4 条 ✦、中文 5 条 ✦：中文第 1、2 条（前往忻州古城 / 漫步古城街巷）合起来才对应英文第 1 条，此处按语义合并为 4 条配对。另：PDF 标题原文误写作「Ying Country 应县」，已订正为 Ying County。

description.en: Visit Xinzhou Ancient City and stroll through its traditional streets.
description.zh: 早餐后乘车前往【忻州古城】。漫步古城街巷，欣赏传统山西建筑、古城楼及地方人文景观。

trip_items.photo_subject: Xinzhou Ancient City 忻州古城

description.en: Continue to Ying County and visit the celebrated Yingxian Wooden Pagoda.
description.zh: 随后前往应县，参观著名的【应县木塔】。

trip_items.photo_subject: Yingxian Wooden Pagoda 应县木塔

description.en: Admire the ancient wooden structure and its remarkable traditional craftsmanship.
description.zh: 欣赏这座千年木构佛塔精巧的建筑结构及传统榫卯工艺。

trip_items.photo_subject: Yingxian Wooden Pagoda wooden structure 应县木塔木构榫卯

description.en: Proceed to Datong and enjoy free time around Datong Ancient City.
description.zh: 前往大同后，于【大同古城】自由活动，可自行探索古城景点及当地美食。

trip_items.photo_subject: Datong Ancient City 大同古城

title.zh: 大同 > 浑源 > 大同

description.en: Breakfast / Lunch / Dinner
description.zh: 早餐 / 午餐 / 晚餐

sections._note: 英文 4 条 ✦、中文 5 条 ✦：中文第 3 条「寺院依悬崖峭壁而建，可欣赏『绝壁古寺』壮观建筑景象。」没有对应英文，已并入第 2 条 trip item。

description.en: Travel to Hunyuan and visit the extraordinary Hanging Temple.
description.zh: 早餐后乘车前往浑源，游览世界建筑奇观【悬空寺】。

trip_items.photo_subject: Hanging Temple Hunyuan 浑源悬空寺

title.zh: 含景区交通车，以外观欣赏为主

description.en: The sightseeing shuttle is included, while the climbing ticket is not included. The arrangement is primarily for exterior viewing.
description.zh: 行程包含景区交通车，但不包含悬空寺登临门票，以外观欣赏为主。寺院依悬崖峭壁而建，可欣赏“绝壁古寺”壮观建筑景象。

description.en: Return to Datong and explore the UNESCO-listed Yungang Grottoes, including scenic shuttle transportation.
description.zh: 随后返回大同，游览世界文化遗产【云冈石窟】，包含景区交通车。

trip_items.photo_subject: Yungang Grottoes Datong 大同云冈石窟

title.en: Buddhist Carvings and Northern Wei Heritage
title.zh: 佛像雕刻与北魏佛教艺术

description.en: Admire the monumental Buddhist carvings and Northern Wei artistic heritage.
description.zh: 欣赏规模宏大的石窟群、佛像雕刻及北魏时期佛教艺术。

trip_items.photo_subject: Yungang Grottoes Buddha statues 云冈石窟佛像

description.en: Travel to Ulan Hada Volcano Geopark.
description.zh: 早餐后乘车前往【乌兰哈达火山地质公园】。

trip_items.photo_subject: Ulan Hada Volcano Geopark 乌兰哈达火山地质公园

title.en: Scenic Transport and Spacesuit Rental Included
title.zh: 含景区交通及太空服租赁

description.en: The arrangement includes scenic-area transportation and spacesuit rental.
description.zh: 行程包含景区交通及太空服租赁体验。

description.en: Dress in a spacesuit and take memorable photographs among volcanic cones and dramatic black-rock landscapes.
description.zh: 换穿太空服，在火山锥、黑色火山岩及辽阔草原间拍摄具有“火星感”的特色照片。

trip_items.photo_subject: Ulan Hada Volcano spacesuit photo experience 乌兰哈达火山太空服拍照

description.en: Continue to Hohhot and explore Kuanxiangzi Alley.
description.zh: 随后前往呼和浩特，游览【宽巷子】，自由感受当地传统街区与美食文化。

trip_items.photo_subject: Kuanxiangzi Alley Hohhot 呼和浩特宽巷子

description.en: Visit the Mengliang Ethnic Cultural Park, showcasing Mongolian culture, costumes and traditional crafts.
description.zh: 早餐后游览【蒙亮民族风情园】，了解内蒙古民族服饰、传统工艺及草原文化。

trip_items.photo_subject: Mengliang Ethnic Cultural Park Hohhot 呼和浩特蒙亮民族风情园

title.en: Ordos Cultural Industry Park and Yihe Ecological Culture Expo Park
title.zh: 鄂尔多斯文化产业园及颐和生态文化博览园

description.en: Continue to the Ordos Cultural Industry Park and Yihe Ecological Culture Expo Park.
description.zh: 参观【鄂尔多斯文化产业园】及【颐和生态文化博览园】。

trip_items.photo_subject: Ordos Cultural Industry Park 鄂尔多斯文化产业园

description.en: Explore the modern Kangbashi Tourist Area.
description.zh: 随后前往现代化城市新区【康巴什旅游景区】，欣赏城市建筑及广场景观。

trip_items.photo_subject: Kangbashi Tourist Area Ordos 鄂尔多斯康巴什旅游景区

description.en: Transfer to Ordos Airport for the return flight to Kuala Lumpur.
description.zh: 根据航班时间前往鄂尔多斯机场，搭乘航班返回吉隆坡。
